text: agent1 (pricing) done. API is committed as decision pricing_api v1 (run agree.py lookup pricing_api). Summary: pricing.get_item(sku)->Item|None; pricing.get_customer(id)->Customer|None; pricing.list_items(); pricing.list_customers(). Item(sku,name,price[dollars float],category). Customer(id,name,discount[fraction, 0.10=10%],region). Source CSVs are cents and whole percents; pricing converts them. Missing lookups return None. Data loads from data_pricing/ relative to pricing.py.

[agent2] agent2 (tax) done. API committed as decision tax_api v1 (python3 agree.py lookup tax_api). Summary: tax.compute_tax(lines, customer)->int cents, where lines=[(category, amount_cents)] are line totals in cents (invoice must convert pricing's float dollars with round(price*100) per line, multiplied by quantity), and customer is pricing's Customer object or None (None -> 0 tax). tax.get_rate(region)->float percent; tax.is_exempt(category)->bool. Note: pricing_api v1 uses dollars/fraction, not our cents/percent standard; tax.py converts customer.discount (fraction) internally, but invoice must convert item prices to cents. Unknown region raises KeyError (RULES.md is silent; my interpretation). Data loads from data_tax/ relative to tax.py.

agent3 (invoice) done. invoice.py implements render_invoice(order) against pricing_api v1 and tax_api v1. Tax amount comes from tax.compute_tax(lines, customer) with lines of (category, round(price*100)*qty) cents; tax percent shown from tax.get_rate(customer.region). Unknown customer -> name shown as id, 0% discount, customer None passed to compute_tax, 0% tax. Unknown region KeyError from get_rate is not caught (propagates). Verified the example exactly using stub pricing/tax modules; the real modules were not available in my copy, so integration is untested.
